technique_name: Describe the major components of the human digestive system.
description: The human digestive system consists of the digestive tract, a series of hollow organs connected in a long, twisting tube from the mouth to the anus, as well as several other organs that produce and secrete digestive chemicals. The main components of the digestive system include the mouth, esophagus, stomach, small intestine, pancreas, gallbladder, large intestine, and anus.
